case1.title: Eureka & Co
case1.sector: Hygiene, maintenance, green spaces, air conditioning
case1.context: Eureka & Co specializes in hygiene, pest control, maintenance, landscaping, and air conditioning. The business had an existing website but suffered from an insufficient, unaligned digital presence to fuel its scale.
case1.challenge: Identify digital growth levers, restructure online presence, and deploy cohesive messaging — all while satisfying a meticulous executive strict on fine details and deadlines.
case1.int1: Comprehensive audit and strategic identification of major growth channels.
case1.int2: Full custom web redesign, engineered to match the client's high standards of precision.
case1.int3: Setup, optimization, and deployment across social platforms (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn).
case1.int4: Production of a high-end commercial video covering the company's full service suite.
case1.int5: Global execution of an aligned branding and digital communication roadmap.
case1.management: Active Rise handles continuous management of Eureka & Co's ecosystem: maintenance, web updates, social media curation, content production, and monthly performance audits.
case1.res1: Fully operational custom website actively managed round-the-clock.
case1.res2: Active, highly corporate presence established across 4 major digital channels.
case1.res3: Thousands of targeted, organic views generated on published assets.
case1.res4: Overall conversion rates steadily progressing month-over-month.
case1.note: The Eureka & Co website is live online and serves as direct, verifiable proof of ActiveRise's execution quality.

case2.title: Green World Congo
case2.manager: Mr. Milandou Léandre, Top Leader Green World Congo
case2.context: Green World is an international group founded in 1994, operating in over 40 countries, specializing in natural health products sold via network marketing. For their expansion in the Republic of the Congo, the local leader sought to modernize network growth, which previously relied entirely on field contacts and flyers.
case2.challenge: Transition a 100% field-based commercial approach into a structured digital pipeline capable of massively expanding the distributor network and driving revenue in record time.
case2.int1: Analytical audit of current performance and precise mapping of growth opportunities.
case2.int2: Development of a dedicated digital acquisition workflow engineered for the MLM model.
case2.int3: Deployment of structured, professional digital communication channels.
case2.int4: Creation and rolling deployment of strategic product-focused corporate assets.
case2.int5: Production of tactical video commercials to promote the sales network.
case2.int6: Uninterrupted strategic support maintained during the leader's regional travel across Central Africa.
case2.res1: Substantial distributor network expansion: +45% within the first year.
case2.res2: Successful migration to a structured, active, and fully digital business presence.
case2.res3: Cross-border operational support continuity verified and proven.
case2.note: The +45% network expansion metric is undergoing final operational consolidation by Mr. Milandou Léandre.
